verdict.rationale: cfo.ai publishes llms.txt files at both cfo.ai/llms.txt and docs.cfo.ai/llms.txt; a probe confirmed the docs one returns HTTP 200 with a markdown index. It also serves agent-oriented markdown docs (agents/index.md, agents/mcp-tools.md) and a skill.md that users paste into Claude Code or Codex. missing for 10: independent or hands-on evidence that an agent pointed at these docs actually completes tasks from them.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
